answer.reason: The verses tell of Ahithophel's counsel to Absalom and his death, beyond what the summary says.

clauses.english: advised Absalom to go in to his father's concubines
clauses.quote: Go in unto thy father's concubines, which he hath left to keep the house

clauses.english: hanged himself when his counsel was not followed
clauses.quote: he saddled his ass, and arose, and gat him home to his house

doubts: 2SA 17:23 quote chosen is the verse's start; the hanging is stated later in the same verse.
2SA 23:34 names Ahithophel only as father of Eliam, so it was left out.
